phase: Phase 5 - Independent Scientific Consistency and Refutation Audit (Updated with BAT26-53 DC/DC & Zero-Seq)

checks.refutation_attempt: Verified all frequency metrics derive from dynamic x[10]=omega.
Audited Vdc window separation and explained why +40% with BESS has slightly lower frequency nadir (49.97562 Hz vs 49.97568 Hz) due to higher V_PCC keeping constant-Z load at 3908 W vs 3535 W.

nadir_tradeoff.physical_explanation: Without BESS, DC-link voltage collapses to 311.52 V (< 327.50 V), saturating modulation at m=0.95 and drooping V_PCC to 100.92 V. Because the R-L load is constant-impedance (P ~ V^2/R), load demand self-limits to 3535.36 W, reducing the active-power torque deficit (P_ref - P_e) in the swing equation. With BESS+DCDC, Vdc is held at 338.60 V (> 327.50 V) and V_PCC stays near nominal (106.10 V), so the load draws 3908.01 W (+372.65 W more than without BESS). That higher P_e produces a slightly deeper frequency nadir (49.97562 Hz vs 49.97568 Hz, delta = -62.6 uHz), which remains well inside the 0.50 Hz criterion (0.0271 Hz drop).

checks.refutation_attempt: Verified p_bridge/p_inv_dc = 0.97 and p_pcc < p_bridge across all cases.
Checked DC capacitor balance, DC/DC power-loss conservation, and 1RC bank decomposition across 13 trajectories.

Verified 48-module 2s2p bank (96 2p units, 360 V nom, 44.1 Ah) operates bidirectionally both below 340 V (328.47 V at SoC 0.12) and above 340 V (363.75 V at SoC 0.60), with distinct I_bank vs I_bus and exact DC/DC conversion losses. Parametric simulation only, NOT experimental.

Refuted any claim that YNyn0 intrinsically blocks zero-sequence current: when a 4-wire grounded neutral exists on the inverter side, YNyn0 transmits I0 = 0.3059 A (416 V side) and skews phase powers by 0.1209 kW. Only 3-wire open-zero-sequence inverter or Ynd blocks I0.

Checked 24h QSTS energy conservation and physical sizing coherence against the BAT26-53 15.876 kWh bank (3.82 kWh daily cycle = 24.1% SoC swing, feasible within [0.10, 0.90]), while keeping 6.5 s ODE and 24 h QSTS strictly separated.
Preserved 9.54% max phase active power discrepancy vs IEEE PES 2015 summary table.
